No. 2035/47 – FRIDAY SEPTEMBER 08, 2017
EXTRAORDINARY
MINISTRY OF LAND AND PARLIAMENTORY
REFORMS LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AMENDED BY LAND
ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT)
ACT, NO. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: 4/1/5/25
Reference No. of the Ministry of Lands and
Parliament Reforms : 4-3/9/2015/WS/27
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the land to be acquired:-

Seven allotments of land called Bakmeegaha Kumbura Kotakanda Kumbura and Dangahamula Kumbura, in total extent of about 0.0213 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 1-2-3-5-7-9-10 and Lot No. 14 in Preliminary Plan No. Ku 2371, dated 29.06.2017, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General situated at the village of Gettuwana (Ward No. 7, within the Municipal Council Limit Kurunegala), in Kurunegala Town East Grama Niladhari Division, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kurunegala in Kurunegala District, North Western Province and bounded as follows.

Lot No. 1 - Name of the Land: Bakmeegaha- kumbura; Name and Address of the Claimants: Mrs. H. A. J. Priyangika, No. 213, Jayanthi Battery Works, Kandy Road, Kurunegala; Extent of the Land: 0.0006 Hectare.

Boundaries North by: Bakmeegaha Kumbura claimed by Mrs. H. A. J. Priyangika; East by: Lot No. 3 and Lot No. 4 in this plan; South by: Lot No. 2 in this plan; West by: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Bakmeegaha Kumbura claimed by Mr. Priyantha Ketawala.
Lot No. 3 - Name of the Land: Bakmeegaha- kumbura; Name and Address of the Claimants: Claiment is not known; Extent of the Land: 0.0016 Hectare.

Boundaries : North by: Bakmeegaha Kumbura claimed by Mrs. H. A. J. Priyangika; East by: Lot No. 5 and Lot No. 6 in this plan; South by: Lot No. 4 and Lot No. 2 in this plan; West by: Lot No. 1 in this plan.
Lot No. 5 - Name of the Land: Bakmeegaha- kumbura; Name and Address of the Claimants: Claiment is not known; Extent of the Land: 0.0039 Hectare.

Boundaries : North by: Bakmeegaha Kumbura claimed by Mrs. H. A. J. Priyangika and Bakmeegaha Kumbura claimant is not known; East by: Lot No. 7 in this plan; South by: Lot No. 6 in this plan; West by: Lot No. 6 in this plan and Bakmeegaha Kumbura claimed by Mrs. H. A. J. Priyangika.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands/Survitudes are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretary’s Office, at Kurunegala on the 06th day of December 2017 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 29th day of November 2017, the nature of their interest in the land,/servitudes the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. E. M. M. S. EKANAYAKE, Divisional Secretary, Kurunegala.
